integrity_statement: The complete all-length proof is analytic and the short-length checker is a reproducibility aid; no independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The word is not recurrent; this does not treat minimal alphabets or recurrent aperiodic words. Unindexed differently formulated prior work may exist. The finite checker is not an infinite proof.
title: An aperiodic word with reflection-to-factor complexity limit three quarters
